$comment: The shape of the private per-term acceptance record that bin/lib/release-terms.mjs reads from the sidecar (monitor/release-term-acceptances.json) or from CW_RELEASE_TERM_ACCEPTANCES. Both rows here are PENDING, which accepts nothing: a pending row is the question the gate asks, and the occurrence stays open. An accepting disposition — generic-capability, public-by-design, upstream-content, detector-defect — additionally needs the reason, a test another person can apply, a reviewer, a date, and the evidence digest of the measurement it is granted against. The gate recomputes that digest from the file, rule, term, where, count and the pattern that fired; a new occurrence changes the count, so the acceptance lapses rather than covering it. Every file and term here is synthetic, from monitor/release-terms.example.json.

acceptances.$comment: A ruling here would say which capability the module provides and name the interface instead of the tool, per the publication boundary.
A module named after a private tool discloses the tool and describes nothing; the ruling on this one is a rename, not an acceptance.
